item.title: Qwen3.8-27B Pre-Release Page Appears on Hugging Face, Signaling Imminent Launch
item.summary: A pre-release page for Qwen3.8-27B appeared on Hugging Face under the official Qwen namespace on August 13, 2026, signaling an imminent open-weight model launch from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team. No weights, benchmarks, or licensing details have been published yet.
